title: Anthropic is expanding to Colossus2. Will use GB200
summary: Anthropic is expanding their AI infrastructure to Colossus2, a next-generation supercomputer cluster that will utilize NVIDIA's GB200 Grace Blackwell processors for training and running large language models at scale.
problem_solved: Scaling AI compute infrastructure to meet the demands of training and deploying frontier AI models with greater efficiency and processing power.
why_valuable: The GB200 chips represent cutting-edge AI accelerator technology that can significantly reduce training time and costs for large language models.
